description: Original train row id (lowest id kept when duplicates were merged)
derivation: raw record_id

description: Test row id; join key for the submission
derivation: raw row_id

description: Canonical zone label (12 values)
derivation: normalize_zone(raw zone)

description: Start of the hour, Addis Ababa local time (EAT, naive)
derivation: parsed from 3 raw formats

description: TARGET: trips requested in the zone-hour
derivation: sentinels -> NaN, x8 spikes / 8, duplicates averaged

description: Average fare (analysis/demo only, NOT a model input)
derivation: raw, duplicates averaged

description: Average wait (analysis only, NOT a model input)
derivation: -1 -> NaN, duplicates averaged

description: Active drivers (analysis only, NOT a model input)
derivation: raw, duplicates averaged

description: observed (history) or forecast (1-14 Nov); info only
derivation: weather.data_type

description: How many of the 4 lags were found before filling; info only
derivation: count of non-missing lags

description: Zones differ in level and daily shape
derivation: index of zone in the 12 canonical labels

description: Strong daily cycle (commute peaks)
derivation: pickup_hour.hour (0-23, local)

description: Weekday vs weekend demand shapes differ
derivation: pickup_hour.dayofweek (0=Mon)

description: Business zones drop, nightlife zones rise at weekends
derivation: day_of_week >= 5

description: Seasonality (rainy season Jun-Sep)
derivation: pickup_hour.month

description: Holidays change city-wide demand
derivation: date of pickup_hour is a listed public holiday

description: Fewer school/commute trips
derivation: date inside a school-break period

description: Riders may spend more around payday
derivation: day >= days_in_month - 2 or day <= 2

description: Demand grows through the year; lets the model follow the trend
derivation: (date - 2025-01-01) in days

description: A newly launched zone (Ayat) ramps up
derivation: days since the zone's first record (0 before launch)

description: Comfort affects walking vs riding
derivation: cleaned temperature at the local hour (forecast for Nov)

description: Rain pushes people into cars
derivation: rain in the previous hour, mm

description: Wet streets keep demand up after rain stops
derivation: sum of rain_mm over this and the 2 previous hours

description: Non-linear dose-response
derivation: 0 none, 1 light (<=1 mm), 2 moderate (<=4 mm), 3 heavy (>4 mm)

description: Proxy for rainy/overcast conditions
derivation: cleaned relative humidity

description: Weather discomfort
derivation: cleaned wind speed

description: Lets the model discount filled values
derivation: 1 if any weather value at this hour was imputed

description: Arrivals before an event
derivation: 1 if within 2 h before a confirmed event start in this zone

description: Activity during the event
derivation: 1 if the hour overlaps a confirmed event in this zone

description: Crowds leave at the end - the largest expected spike
derivation: 1 if within 2 h after a confirmed event end in this zone

description: Bigger crowds, bigger spike
derivation: max attendance of events whose window covers the hour (blank -> type median), else 0

description: Overlapping events stack
derivation: number of confirmed events whose window covers the hour

description: Build-up before an event
derivation: hours until the next event start in this zone (capped at 24)

description: Decay after an event
derivation: hours since the last event end in this zone (capped at 24)

description: Event types have different effects
derivation: 1 if inside the pre/during/post window of a confirmed football_match

description: Event types have different effects
derivation: 1 if inside the pre/during/post window of a confirmed concert

description: Event types have different effects
derivation: 1 if inside the pre/during/post window of a confirmed conference

description: Event types have different effects
derivation: 1 if inside the pre/during/post window of a confirmed exhibition

description: Event types have different effects
derivation: 1 if inside the pre/during/post window of a confirmed sports_run

description: Closures can suppress or divert trips
derivation: 1 if a confirmed road closure is in force in this zone

description: Recent level of the same zone-hour; >= 14 days so it is known for every forecast hour
derivation: trips in the same zone and hour 14 days earlier (missing -> mean of the other lags)

description: Recent level of the same zone-hour; >= 14 days so it is known for every forecast hour
derivation: trips in the same zone and hour 21 days earlier (missing -> mean of the other lags)

description: Recent level of the same zone-hour; >= 14 days so it is known for every forecast hour
derivation: trips in the same zone and hour 28 days earlier (missing -> mean of the other lags)

description: Recent level of the same zone-hour; >= 14 days so it is known for every forecast hour
derivation: trips in the same zone and hour 35 days earlier (missing -> mean of the other lags)

description: Smoothed recent same-weekday-same-hour level
derivation: mean of trips_lag_{14,21,28,35}d
